purpose: Alternative material — different material variants of same design
prompt:
Material variant photograph for 脸谱潮 LIANPU CHAO — same opera mask design rendered in different materials.

Scene: Four versions of the same deconstructed Guan Yu opera mask design, each on a different material substrate, arranged in a 2x2 grid on rice-paper #f5f0e8 background:

1. TOP-LEFT — WOOD: Laser-engraved on light birch wood. The mask pattern is burned into the wood surface, showing warm brown tones. Natural wood grain visible. Organic, craft feel.

2. TOP-RIGHT — ACRYLIC: Clear acrylic with the mask pattern printed in cinnabar-red #e8433f and ink-black #1a1a2e on the back surface, creating depth through the transparent material. Modern, glossy.

3. BOTTOM-LEFT — BRASS: Etched brass metal plate in gold-leaf #d4a843 tone. The mask pattern is chemically etched into the metal, creating recessed lines. Premium, durable, tactile.

4. BOTTOM-RIGHT — FABRIC: Screen-printed on canvas fabric. The mask pattern in cinnabar-red #e8433f and ink-black #1a1a2e with bold thick outlines. Textile texture visible. Casual, wearable.

All four versions maintain the same symmetrical deconstructed mask design — demonstrating the design system's versatility across materials. Each material's unique texture and quality is clearly distinguishable.

Style: Product photography, even lighting, clean background. Real material textures visible. The 2x2 arrangement creates a satisfying visual comparison.
